technique_name: Name at least three ways machine learning can be used in a retail store
description:
Machine learning can be used in a retail store in many ways. 
Firstly, it can be used to improve customer engagement by analyzing customer feedback and buying patterns and creating tailored product recommendations. Secondly, it can be used to enhance inventory management, by looking at the data regarding supply and demand and creating predictive models to help make better stocking decisions.
